newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble unaffected by Yeltsin operation news.
newsitem.headline: Rouble unaffected by Yeltsin operation news.

text.p: The rouble was unaffected by news President Boris Yeltsin agreed to have a heart operation as the majority of operators had already left the market, which is usually indifferent to such political news, dealers said.
Yeltsin agreed to have a heart operation which is likely to take place at the end of September in Moscow, RIA Novosti news agency said.
"Most banks are already not trading and those who still are have not reacted in any way," an Interbank Finance House dealer said.
Dealers said active trading on the interbank market usually stops at 1300 GMT.
"Our market is usually not affected by such things, so even if it had happened earlier we would not have seen anything," another dealer said.
But the Interbank Finance House dealer said the news could boost dollar demand slightly on Friday.
Roubles for tomorrow settlement were quoted at 5,367-69 per dollar compared with an early 5,366-69 and 5,365-68 late on Wednesday.
The central bank said it had set 5,333/5,373 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Thursday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 10-20 percent compared with an early 40-50 percent and yesterday's late 20-50 percent.
